run.source: gpu-pytorch-g5g-2b/sweep.py + make_report.py; rig gpu-jax-g5g-2b; run dir 2026-08-31-crossrig-jax-g5g
run.notes: JAX leg of the first controlled three-runtime comparison on g5g (vLLM / JAX / PyTorch), all three on g5g.2xlarge in us-east-1a on the same day, driven by gpu-pytorch-g5g-2b/sweep.py with --decode-source both so every rig reports the same client-side streaming statistic. Config is this rig's shipped default, ple4+int8head, which is quantised where the other two legs are dense - see the cross-rig REPORT.md for that fairness caveat. Full analysis in gpu-pytorch-g5g-2b/benchmarks/runs/2026-08-31-crossrig-torch-g5g/REPORT.md.

pricing.source: aws ec2 describe-spot-price-history, us-east-1a, spot, at run time

model.architecture_notes: E2B under the rig's own JAX port (ports/gemma4), not transformers: hand-written KV ring with a bucket ladder, so pad_len and bucket_size are recorded per request.

memory.notes: PLE 4-bit plus int8 lm_head: 6.155 GB resident against the dense rig's 10.209 GB. The PLE table is a gather, never a matmul, so it is resident but not streamed during decode.

notes: Decode 12.66-13.20 tok/s across a 92-3746 token context range: flat, so decode is set by the weights rather than by the context.
